How to use them

Bleed, safe area, trim

01

Bleed (pink)

Run backgrounds and images right out to the edge of the pink area. It’s trimmed off after printing.

02

Safe area (blue)

Keep text, logos and anything important inside the blue area, clear of the trim.

03

Trim and folds

The page edge is the finished size. Folded leaflets show each panel and the page order.

04

Export and send

Hide the template layers, export a print PDF in CMYK with bleed and crop marks, then upload it or email it to us.
